name: Gudok
instructions: 1. Chop all vegetables into medium-sized chunks.
2. In a pot, add the vegetables, green chilies, garlic, and a small piece of berma with a minimal amount of water.
3. Cover and boil until the vegetables are tender and the water has almost completely evaporated.
4. Remove from heat and transfer the mixture to a large bowl or mortar.
5. Add raw onions and salt to taste.
6. Mash all ingredients together thoroughly using a pestle or a heavy spoon until it achieves a rustic, chunky consistency.
7. Serve warm, usually as a side dish with steamed rice.
description: Gudok is the quintessential traditional dish of the Tripuri people. It is characterized by the distinct, pungent flavor of 'berma' (fermented fish), which provides a deep umami base. It holds immense cultural significance as a staple comfort food often prepared during communal gatherings and festivals.
